axis_selection: Agent-chosen. PRUNE is the only axis an R0 child can edit without inheriting the sub-3 px collar (IR-88-47); MASS/CONCENTRATION/SNAP/RELIEF/SPACING/TRACKB are all closed as slot axes on this lineage in SLOT_PLAN.md.
design: Matched triplet at collar 3 px, 2,171 donors, N 37,654, same pool, same seed: lock 2.8 px (dose down), lock 4.5 px (dose up), lock 3.5 px with random refill order (ranking control against the ledgered p3space35).
refill_ranking_basis: Exact iterative marginal expected-DTI gain (vendor/gems57/metric.py) among only those refill cells that keep a >= spacing_px separation from every surviving R0 dot and from every already-chosen refill; candidate pool = union of the H19-5, H19-4 and H16-1 ridge supports outside the collar; one fixed label-free four-line physical field for all arms
random_control_basis: No ranking at all: a seeded (20261024) uniformly random order over the same spacing-legal refill pool, with the same blocking rule and the same feasibility lookahead, so the count and the spacing statistics are matched to p3space35 and only the ordering rule differs
physical_field: label-free four-line physical field from scripts/build_prune_variants.py: surface scarp, subsurface potential-field, strain/seismic and hydrothermal lines
predictions_are: MODEL, registered before any PROXY/SGMC instrument ran

variants.hypothesis: A 2.8 px lock is just under the 3 px kernel radius, so neighbouring refills still share kernel support: the arm should recover only part of the spacing-locked gain and land between the densifying R1 (blind +0.0000) and p3space35 (blind +0.0050).

At a 4.5 px lock no two refill dots share the triangular R=3 px kernel, so each one is the nearest dot to a distinct strip of ground and pays full line credit instead of the 0.04-0.07 TP/dot a densified refill forfeits; it should therefore beat p3space35 (blind +0.0050) if the effect is monotone in separation.

The spacing-locked gain is geometric, not field-driven: if the 3.5 px lock already sets the geometry, a random refill order should reproduce most of p3space35's blind margin and the four-line field contributes little (the MASS random-donor control bounded the ranking effect at +-0.0018).
